Name: Wedding Dialogue Fix
Author: himanbam
Description:
During the wedding event, there is a bug that cuts out the part where Lewis actually pronounces you married. Meaning that you are not legally married to your Stardew Valley spouse :(
This mod fixes that.

[u]The Issue:[/u]

Where he is supposed to say: 
"<farmer name>... <spouse name>...", "As the mayor of Pelican Town, and regional bearer of the matrimonial seal, I now pronounce you husband and wife!", "You may kiss."

He instead says:
﻿"<farmer name>...",  "You may kiss."

As far as I can tell, it's just a simple mistake in the event, where it should have 2 more "EscapedText" tokens, to handle the spaces. It's missing those, so it just stops after the first space.
I changed that and it solved it. I tested with the 4 combinations of farmer and spouse gender and they all worked.

[u]Compatability:[/u]

This was made for 1.16.15 and only tested with that. I don't know if other versions have the same issue, but it's possible it could work for those too.

Because this patches the wedding event itself, any mods that replace the default wedding event or edit the same section of the event may not be compatible.

However, most wedding dialogue changes should be fine with this, if they change the Strings/StringsFromCS asset. The event still uses the localized strings from that, which would include any modded dialogue.

Similarly, this should work for all languages too.

Downloads.Description: Patches the event to fix the missing dialogue issue.
